Controls: WASD=move, arrows=shoot, E=bomb, Space=item, Q=pills/cards. Started in tutorial room with control placard. Moved through bottom door into main room. Room contains: poop pile at ~(0.52,0.37), chest at ~(0.68,0.50), gold door at bottom, open door at top. Used 2 bombs (had 1, now 0) destroying rocks, damaging character (3→2.5 hearts). Poop pile resisted extensive tear attacks (80+ shots fired) without breaking—hypothesis: poop is indestructible or requires special mechanic. Chest tested by walking into it—confirmed requires key to open. Thought blue fly enemy appeared at top, fired many upward tears; realized 'fly' was actually tear splash effect on top wall—no enemy present. Top doorway is open. Minimap shows rooms above and to sides. Character currently at ~(0.50,0.31) after aligning with top door at x≈0.50. Current stats: 2.5 hearts, 0 bombs, 0 keys, 0 coins. Active goal: exit through top door to explore adjacent room and find key or progression path. Uncertainty: purpose of indestructible poop pile, whether chest is required for progress, what lies in adjacent rooms.
